projects.title: New Love Plus+ English Patch
projects.status: v1.0.0-rc3 release candidate published in September 2026; translation and platform testing remain incomplete
projects.summary: A fan English localization patcher for the Japanese 3DS dating sim. The current release candidate produces an installable CIA, but the project's progress page reports partial dialogue coverage and unproofread machine-pass content; LayeredFS and confirmed CFW/Luma support are not available at this stage.

projects.patch_format: One-click patcher builds an English CIA from a verified decrypted CIA/.3ds/.cci dump; CIA installation is the only supported route in the release candidate
projects.supported_game_build: Japanese 3DS title ID 00040000000F4E00; patcher checks known-good hashes and rejects unmatched dumps
caveats: The maintainer reports 424 of 578 dialogue script packs translated, phone/SMS text at 0%, and system/menu text as a 98.1% machine pass that is unreviewed; progress figures were last updated 2026-09-12.
No CFW/Luma3DS version is confirmed tested; LayeredFS is disabled until the patch leaves release-candidate status.
Patcher requires the user's own decrypted game dump; the project states the patch only modifies that dump.

projects.title: Tomodachi Collection English Translation
projects.platform: Nintendo DS; compatible DS-family systems with the documented loaders
projects.status: Full English patch v1.0 released; some text and graphics remain Japanese by design
projects.summary: A full English fan translation of the Japan-only Nintendo DS game, extending an earlier community patch. It translates the game's readable text while intentionally leaving voice-synthesized lyrics/text, kana keyboard pages, and a few decorative graphics in Japanese.
projects.source_available: xdelta patch only; no ROM is distributed

sources.label: Maintainer README; version, patch format, legal-dump requirement and exact ROM fingerprint

projects.supported_game_build: Japanese Tomodachi Collection NDS game code CCUJ, version 1.1, source MD5 7AB6ACD97168F6D70E953A9C8057337C
caveats: Repository contains a patch, not a ROM; maintainer directs users to apply it to their own clean, legally dumped Japanese cartridge image.
Works on DS-family systems; DSi/3DS play requires TWiLightMenu++ and nds-bootstrap v2.16.0 or newer to handle the game's anti-piracy check.
